# Metadata

Everything a single query can say about a file.

```rux
pub struct Metadata {
    pub kind: FileKind;
    pub size: uint64;
    pub linkCount: uint64;
    pub permissions: Permissions;
    pub accessed: Timestamp;
    pub modified: Timestamp;
    pub hasCreated: bool;
    // private fields
}
```

## Fields

| Name          | Type          | Description                                                                      |
| ------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`        | `FileKind`    | What the name refers to.                                                         |
| `size`        | `uint64`      | The length in bytes; zero for a directory, whose size means nothing portable.    |
| `linkCount`   | `uint64`      | How many names the content has. Always one on a system that does not count them. |
| `permissions` | `Permissions` | Who may do what.                                                                 |
| `accessed`    | `Timestamp`   | When the contents were last read.                                                |
| `modified`    | `Timestamp`   | When the contents were last written.                                             |
| `hasCreated`  | `bool`        | Whether `created` means anything.                                                |

## Related

<h3 id="file-kind"><code>FileKind</code></h3>

```rux
pub enum FileKind: int32 {
    File = 0,
    Directory = 1,
    SymbolicLink = 2,
    Other = 3
}
```

What kind of thing a name refers to.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FileSystem/Src/Metadata.rux#L31)

**Cases**

| Name           | Value | Description                                                                                         |
| -------------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `File`         | `0`   | An ordinary file of bytes.                                                                          |
| `Directory`    | `1`   | A directory.                                                                                        |
| `SymbolicLink` | `2`   | A symbolic link — only ever reported by a no-follow query, since following one lands on its target. |
| `Other`        | `3`   | A device, socket, pipe, or anything else the filesystem holds that is none of the above.            |

<h3 id="metadata-of"><code>MetadataOf</code></h3>

```rux
pub func MetadataOf(allocator: Allocator, path: Path, followLinks: bool) -> Metadata ! IoError
```

Describes the file `path` names.
`followLinks` decides what a symbolic link at the end of the path means: following it describes the target,
and not following it describes the link, which is the only way `SymbolicLink` is ever reported.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FileSystem/Src/Metadata.rux#L362)

**Parameters**

| Name          | Type        | Description                                                     |
| ------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `allocator`   | `Allocator` | where the storage comes from                                    |
| `path`        | `Path`      | the path to act on                                              |
| `followLinks` | `bool`      | whether a final symbolic link is followed rather than described |

**Returns**: what the system knows about the path

<h3 id="set-times"><code>SetTimes</code></h3>

```rux
pub func SetTimes(allocator: Allocator, path: Path, accessed: Timestamp, modified: Timestamp, followLinks: bool) -> ! IoError
```

Sets the access and modification times of the file `path` names.
Creation time is not settable here: Windows would allow it and the Unix systems would not, and an operation
that silently means different things on different systems is worse than one that is not offered.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FileSystem/Src/Metadata.rux#L456)

**Parameters**

| Name          | Type        | Description                                                     |
| ------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `allocator`   | `Allocator` | where the storage comes from                                    |
| `path`        | `Path`      | the path to act on                                              |
| `accessed`    | `Timestamp` | the access time to set, or `None` to leave it                   |
| `modified`    | `Timestamp` | the modification time to set, or `None` to leave it             |
| `followLinks` | `bool`      | whether a final symbolic link is followed rather than described |

**Returns**: success when the times were applied
